rules.name: Covenant
rules.text: Your gathering may only contain models with the Leader, Beast or Remnant keyword.

leaderTrait.name: Crawling Lord
leaderTrait.text: When this leader finishes their activation they can immediately activate a friendly model within 6″ with the Beast or Remnant keyword that has not yet activated.

trait.name: Eternal Loyalty
trait.text: If this model is within 3″ of a friendly leader that is the target of an attack action, this model may choose to become the target of the attack action and is immediately Shattered before any attack dice are rolled. The targeted leader takes no damage.
